# Class exercise - the questions (written by C:/DE10_solutions/class_exercise/gen.py, do not edit).
# [Qnn] NAME | title | npub n [| steps n];  B: board;  Pk: printed for login numbers with pub = k;
# with steps: Sk: the screen of step k (step 0 = login, in run.ps1);  without: L: question, F: answer format

[Q01] GATE | Which gate is hidden in the board? | npub 1 | steps 4 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8 (HEX3, HEX2).  Y = LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: meet the board. A gate is hidden in it: inputs A = SW9, B = SW8, output Y = LEDG0.
S1: Put A B = 0 0 (SW9 and SW8 down). Is the green light LEDG0 on?
S1: ANSWER: SW0 up if LEDG0 is on, SW0 down if it is off.
S2: GOAL: the whole truth table of the gate.
S2: Try A B = 00, 01, 10, 11 (SW9 SW8) and write Y for each row.
S2: ANSWER: SW0 = Y at 00,  SW1 = Y at 01,  SW2 = Y at 10,  SW3 = Y at 11.
S3: GOAL: name the gate. Compare your truth table with what each gate does.
S3: ANSWER - first put SW3 SW2 SW1 SW0 all DOWN, then raise only the switches of your gate:
S3:    AND = (all down)    OR = SW0    XOR = SW1    NAND = SW1 + SW0    NOR = SW2    XNOR = SW2 + SW0

[Q02] SIGMA | Minterms and maxterms of a hidden F | npub 1 | steps 6 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7 (HEX3 HEX2 HEX1).  F = LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: meet F. It has three inputs: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7. F = LEDG0.
S1: Put A B C = 0 0 0 (SW9, SW8, SW7 down). Is LEDG0 on?
S1: ANSWER: SW0 up if LEDG0 is on, SW0 down if it is off.
S2: GOAL: the first half of the truth table - the rows where A = 0 (SW9 down).
S2: Try B C = 00, 01, 10, 11 (SW8 SW7) and write F for each.
S2: ANSWER: SW0 = F at 000,  SW1 = F at 001,  SW2 = F at 010,  SW3 = F at 011.
S3: GOAL: the second half - the rows where A = 1 (SW9 up).
S3: Try B C = 00, 01, 10, 11 again and write F for each.
S3: ANSWER: SW0 = F at 100,  SW1 = F at 101,  SW2 = F at 110,  SW3 = F at 111.
S4: GOAL: minterms. A row where F = 1 is a MINTERM: F = SIGMA(those row numbers).
S4: Count the rows of your table where F = 1.
S4: ANSWER: the number on the switches:   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0
S5: GOAL: maxterms. A row where F = 0 is a MAXTERM: F = PI(those row numbers).
S5: Count the rows of your table where F = 0.
S5: ANSWER: the number on the switches:   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0
